lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: Congratulations!! ♠♠♠♠♠♠♠

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: You're our lucky winner!

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: You've earned a chance to make a bet with me, ♠Spade♠
What do I stand to win?

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: For you, my friend, something special.

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: Something that I'd only offer to Commanders who have been up to the surface.

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: A chance to win ♠300 million♠ credits!
Sounds like a scam.
Explain it a bit more.

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: If you don't believe me, then how about this?

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: You'll first think of 5 friends, and I'll pick one

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: to have a bet with. Who knows, they may just win an incredible ♠prize♠ ^____^
Fine, explain the rules to me.

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: It's simple!

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: I will give you some ♠random coordinates♠

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: and you have to make your way there

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: to see what you'll find.

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: If there are Raptures, no dice!

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: Rapture parts? No dice!

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: If you see a Nikke? ♠Jackpot!♠

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: I'll even accept them if they're, shall we say... no longer with us.
What if I don't find anything?
What if I find Raptures and Nikkes at the same time?

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: Then I'm afraid that's ♠no dice♠ too!

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: However, if you manage to find any Nikkes

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: but isn't able to bring them back to me,

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: I'm afraid that's ♠no dice♠ as well!

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: However, if you manage to bring me back any of the Nikkes,

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: I'll give you a small reward :3
Are you a collector?
What do you want Nikkes for?

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: What a thing to say!

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: I haven't the faintest idea what you mean O.O

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: Anyway, I'll send you a randomized coordinate.

lines.speaker: spade
lines.text: Good luck! ♠♠♠♠♠
